access.title: Recommended access
access.body: Let MONO set what each role sees: staff see their own branch and their daily work; stock, sales, money and hospitality screens go to the people who work in them. You see every change before it is saved.
access.applied: Access set. Check it with "See as this person" in the org chart.
access.failed: Could not work this out. Try again.
access.nothing: Every role already has the recommended access. Nothing to change.
access.intro: Nothing is saved until you press Apply. Afterwards you can still change any role by hand, and look at MONO as any person from the org chart.
access.movesHint: A Member whose department says what they do gets the role of that work, so they keep the screens of their job.
